testerC.modesTitre: How do you want to take the test?
testerC.modesDesc: The questions are the same in both modes! Only the way you answer them is different.
testerC.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the same questions in turn
testerC.q1: How long have you been together?
testerC.q1o2: Between six months and two years
testerC.q2: Have you met each other's family?
testerC.q2o0: Yes, both sides, and we go back regularly
testerC.q2o1: Yes, both sides, once or twice
testerC.q2o3: Never, and the subject is closed
testerC.q3: Do your close friends know your partner?
testerC.q3o0: Yes, they are part of the group
testerC.q3o1: Yes, they have met several times
testerC.q3o2: Two or three have run into them
testerC.q4o0: Yes, for more than a year
testerC.q4o1: Yes, for less than a year
testerC.q4o2: Not yet, but it is decided and dated
testerC.q4o3: No, and it is not on the cards
testerC.q5: Have the two of you been on holiday together?
testerC.q5o0: Several times, and we keep doing it
testerC.q6: Have you been through a real ordeal together (grief, illness, job loss)?
testerC.q6o0: Yes, and we came out closer
testerC.q6o1: Yes, it shook us but we held on
testerC.q6o3: We have never been through that together
testerC.q7: On the big life decisions (children, marriage, where to live), where do you stand?
testerC.q7o0: Decided together, and we are acting on them
testerC.q7o1: We know what we want, without a date
testerC.q8: Do you share concrete commitments (lease, account, loan, pet)?
testerC.q8o2: Nothing yet, but we are considering it
testerC.q8o3: Nothing, and the idea is uncomfortable
testerC.q9: Has there ever been a break-up or a pause in your story?
testerC.q9o1: Once, very early on, long behind us
testerC.q9o2: Yes, and the subject still comes back
testerC.q9o3: Several times, we are in a cycle
testerC.q10: The last time you needed them urgently?
testerC.q10o2: They found a reason not to come
testerC.q10o3: I do not even call any more
testerC.q11: During an argument, is breaking up put on the table?
testerC.q11o0: Never, that is not a weapon we use
testerC.q11o2: It comes up as soon as voices rise
testerC.q11o3: It has become the usual threat
testerC.q12: After an argument, how long before you speak again?
testerC.q12o0: A few hours, we do not let it fester
testerC.q12o3: We wait for it to pass, and never revisit it
testerC.q13: If you had to bet on your relationship five years from now?
testerC.q14: How does your partner introduce you to other people?
testerC.q15: Do the people around you support your relationship?
testerC.q15o3: Several close friends have warned us
testerC.q16: Are you included in the important moments of their family?
testerC.q16o0: Yes, like a member of the family
testerC.q17o0: What is said gets done, on both sides
testerC.q17o2: I often have to remind them
testerC.q17o3: I have stopped believing in them
testerC.q18: Does a big argument put everything back in question?
testerC.q18o0: No, we know we will still be here afterwards
testerC.q18o3: We no longer dare raise what hurts
testerC.q19: Do the same arguments come round in loops?
testerC.q19o0: No, what is settled stays settled
testerC.q19o1: One or two come back sometimes
testerC.q19o3: Always the same ones, word for word
testerC.q20: Do you have a clear picture of each other's finances?
testerC.q20o0: Yes, everything is transparent on both sides
testerC.q20o3: No, and questions are badly received
testerC.q21: Are your personal plans compatible (career, city, lifestyle)?
testerC.q21o0: Yes, we are building in the same direction
testerC.q21o2: There is one friction point never resolved
testerC.q21o3: We know they pull against each other
testerC.q22: Does each of you keep a life of your own (friends, activities)?
testerC.q22o0: Yes, and it feeds the relationship
testerC.q22o2: Not much, we do almost everything together
testerC.q22o3: No, one of us gave it all up
testerC.q23: Who do you turn to first when something serious happens?
testerC.q23o2: More likely a friend or my family
testerC.q24: Are you afraid they will leave?
testerC.q24o0: No, that is not a question for us
testerC.q24o3: It is a constant background fear
testerC.q25: Have your two circles of friends and family ever met?
testerC.q25o2: Never, but we are thinking about it
testerC.q25o3: Never, and it would make no sense for us
testerC.q26: Has there ever been a betrayal or a serious lie?
testerC.q26o2: Yes, and trust has not fully returned
testerC.q26o3: Yes, and it still weighs today
testerC.q27: If an opportunity forced one of you to move far away?
testerC.q27o0: We would build the solution together
testerC.q27o1: We would talk about it seriously
testerC.q27o2: It would trigger a major crisis
testerC.q27o3: It would probably be the end
testerC.q28: When did one of you last seriously consider leaving?
testerC.q28o1: A long time ago, and it is settled
testerC.q29o2: Often by just one of us
testerC.q29o3: Each of us on our own
testerC.q30: What about transparency on phones, nights out, accounts?
testerC.q30o1: Good, with private areas we both accept
testerC.q30o2: There is a vagueness that bothers me
testerC.q31: Has distance ever been tested (travel, shifts, time apart)?
testerC.q31o0: Yes, and the bond held effortlessly
testerC.q31o1: Yes, it was hard but we held on
testerC.q31o2: Yes, and it damaged things badly
testerC.q31o3: Never, and I have doubts about how we would cope
testerC.q32: Over the last twelve months, your relationship has...
testerC.q32o3: Taken a hit it has not recovered from
testerC.q33: If you found yourself alone for a whole weekend?
testerC.q33o0: I would enjoy it, no question about it
testerC.q33o2: I would be at a loose end
testerC.q33o3: I would take it very badly
